name: Trigiant Group Limited
summary: Trigiant Group Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells feeder cables, optical fiber cables and related products, flame-retardant flexible cables, and other accessories for mobile communications and telecommunication equipment in China. It operates through Feeder Cable Series, Flame-Retardant Flexible Cable Series, Optical Fibre Cable Series and Related Products, New-Type Electronic Components, and Others segments. The Feeder Cable Series segment offers cables used in transmitting and receiving radio signals, and components for telecommunications transmission equipment; and leaky cables primarily used for wireless mobile communications, remote control, and alarm systems…
